_note: The weekly code review's findings for the app and the website (BRIEF_CODE_AUDIT.md). Rows are never deleted; status is open, fixed (with fixed_in) or declined (with Hidde's words). The review reads this first so nothing is reported twice.

findings.summary: A corrected pin, new photo or fixed name reaches the map only after a restart: the redraw compares tree ids only.
findings.fix: Redraw when the drawn fields differ, keeping the same-array fast path.

findings.summary: Own pins compare ids only and the route only its point count.
findings.fix: Compare coordinates, photo presence and route identity.

findings.summary: The account may load twice at cold launch, running two merges at once.
A photo can download twice in one merge.
The map style always loads from the web; a cold start without signal may draw no map.
findings.fix: Bundle the style, refresh from the web.
findings.why: MapLibre keeps the style in its own cache and uses it offline after the first load; only a first launch with no signal draws no map, and then no tiles are on the phone either

findings.summary: After sign-in the camera sheet is presented while the sign-in sheet is still closing.
findings.fix: Present after the first sheet has gone.
findings.why: the callback fires from nudge.sheetGone() after the sign-in sheet has gone, the existing chaining pattern

findings.summary: Two share URLs are force-unwrapped from a slug.
The map list filters and sorts every tree on every pan and drag frame.
findings.fix: Memoise per settled region and filters.

findings.summary: Search rebuilds its city list and ranks twice on every keystroke.
findings.fix: Build once per open, rank once per query.

findings.summary: My trees makes three requests every time the tab appears.
findings.fix: Once per session and on refresh.

findings.summary: Every map repaints about once a second for a season halo that is switched off.
findings.fix: Goes with the Season code being set aside (Hidde, 2026-11-04).

findings.summary: Walks, Season and Plus are dark in the store build but their code still runs.
findings.fix: Set the code aside; it stays in git history.
findings.note: Hidde, 2026-11-04: "set the code aside - we will come back to this but probably completely in a new way"

findings.summary: About a thousand lines nobody reaches: oldBody and its parts, CountryView, CollectionMapPage, PlaceMapPage, dead navigator mailboxes.
Three Add a photo buttons and a separate Collect route for one act.
findings.fix: One camera action in the bottom bar (Google Maps, iNaturalist).
findings.note: Hidde, 2026-11-04, after the drawing and the honest read that the bar camera is the one photo ask left on screen while scrolling: "leave it as is"

findings.summary: Followers and Following open as a sheet while Find people is a page.
findings.fix: Push them, as Instagram and Strava.

findings.summary: Map filter chips clear each other instead of combining.
findings.fix: Additive chips, an active one reopens its picker (Google Maps, Airbnb).

findings.summary: A city chip on a tree page jumps to the Map tab with no way back.
findings.fix: Push the place map inside the current tab.
findings.note: Hidde, 2026-11-04: "Yes, leave it", after the read that a pushed map in every tab would undo the same day's one-map-screen rule and that the tree page stays under the Discover tab

findings.summary: The tree page's two bottom buttons swap at exactly 200 m and jump with GPS drift.
findings.fix: A band, 150 m in and 250 m out.

findings.summary: The same search result does different things in Discover and on the map.
